chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ahmad ibn Muhammad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: 'The one who stipulates a condition opposite to the Book of Allah, it is not valid for him, nor is it valid for the one upon whom it is stipulated, and the Muslims are upon their conditions in what conforms to the Book of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.'
ai.seo_question: What is the validity of conditions in Islamic contracts that do not contradict the Quran?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi delineates the hierarchy of contractual stipulations, affirming that while 'al-muslimun 'ala shurutihim' generally holds, any condition contradicting the Quran is null and void for both parties. It reflects the Shia juristic principle that specific divine injunctions override general contractual freedom, ensuring that private agreements do not infringe upon public or religious law. This ruling is foundational in Usul al-Fiqh for determining the validity of clauses in sales and leases.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, and Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The one who stipulates a condition opposite to the Book of Allah<sup>saww</sup>, so it is not allowed for him, nor is it allowed for whom it is stipulated upon, and the Muslims are with their stipulations regarding what is in accordance with the Book of Allah<sup>saww</sup> Mighty and Majestic’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ahmad ibn Muhammad from all from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘

If one forms a stipulation against the book of Allah, it is not permissible for him as well for the other party. However, the Muslims must stand by their stipulations which agree with the book of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious. 5 ”
